facts.fact: Gabon Media Time reports the communication minister was received on 3 November 2026 at the APDPVP by its president Dominique Joel Ledaga, and that under law no. 25/2023 of 12 July 2023 the authority works to prevent breaches of privacy and fundamental rights.

Gabon Media Time reports the APDPVP, headed by president Dominique Joel Ledaga, received the communication minister on 3 November 2026 and is charged under law no. 25/2023 of 12 July 2023 with protecting privacy and fundamental rights.
